team.name: Vikram Kumar
team.bio: Vikram leads technology at Friensys. A fractional CTO and AI systems & SaaS architect with 20+ years in tech, he helps founders turn AI prototypes into production multi-tenant platforms and builds production AI agents and LLM pipelines. His enterprise work includes web applications for Microsoft India and Redington (Dubai).
